info.title: meta-whatsapp-server
info.description: The meta-whatsapp-rs HTTP service: WhatsApp Business Platform over REST, for apps not written in Rust. Errors: every error answers `ErrorBody`; branch on `error.code` (`ErrorCode`), and resend only when `may_have_been_sent` is false.

200.description: Prometheus metrics, in the OpenMetrics text format

get.summary:
`GET /readyz`: the service takes traffic: storage answers and it is not
shutting down.
List platform keys, revoked ones included.

404.description: `not_found`
`not_found`

delete.summary:
Delete a tenant: disconnect every WABA it has (as
`DELETE /v1/wabas/{waba_id}` does), then delete it and its keys. Stops
at the first WABA that cannot be disconnected; the tenant stays. Its
events go with it, and platform keys stop allowing it: a tenant created
later with the same id polls none of its events and is no platform
key's until allowed again.

204.description: Deleted, with its keys; every WABA disconnected

403.description: Not an admin key, or Meta refused to unsubscribe a WABA

404.description: `not_found`

409.description: A WABA has no usable token (`number_not_connected`, `reconnect_required`): unbind it first

patch.summary: Rename, suspend or reactivate a tenant.

404.description: `not_found`

get.summary: List a tenant's keys, revoked ones included.

404.description: `not_found`: no such tenant

post.summary: Mint a key for a tenant.

404.description: `not_found`: no such tenant

delete.summary:
Revoke a tenant's key. Effective at once, on every replica (keys are
not cached).

404.description: `not_found`: no such key for this tenant

post.summary:
Attach one of the platform's own WABAs to a tenant: list its numbers
from Meta with the given token (so no id is bound on the caller's word),
bind the WABA and those numbers to the tenant (refused when another
tenant has it, decision D4), store the token in the vault, then
subscribe the app to the WABA's webhooks with it.
post.description:
Subscribing the app is the last step: its failure carries
`step: subscribe_app` and `resumable: true`, as the WABA stays
attached and repeating the call finishes it (with a new token after a
`409 reconnect_required`: Meta refused the stored one).

201.description: Attached: its numbers bound, the token stored, the app subscribed to its webhooks

403.description: Not an admin key, or Meta refused the token access to the WABA (nothing bound or stored), or to subscribe the app (`step` `subscribe_app`: the WABA stays attached; repeat the call)

404.description: `not_found`: no such tenant

409.description: `waba_owned_by_another_tenant`; `reconnect_required` with `step` `subscribe_app`: Meta refused the token once it was stored (the WABA stays attached, its numbers `reconnect_required`: repeat the call with a valid token)

422.description: `invalid_request` on `waba_id` (digits), `token` (blank, or refused by Meta when listing the numbers: nothing bound or stored) or `body`; Meta's `invalid_parameter`

502.description: Meta failed, or listed more than 1,000 numbers (`upstream`)

post.summary:
Re-encrypt every bound WABA's token (and its credit ledger) under the
active vault key (`WA_VAULT_KEY`), walking the service's bindings (the
vault cannot list its records). The old key can go once `failed` is
empty. Also `meta-whatsapp-server vault rotate`.
post.description:
The walk is a request like any other, cut at the 55 s request
deadline: one too large to finish in time answers `504 timeout`, part
of the records rotated. It is idempotent: repeat it (records already
under the active key are read, not rewritten), or run
`meta-whatsapp-server vault rotate`, which has no deadline.

200.description: Walked every WABA: how many records were re-encrypted, and which failed

504.description: `timeout`: the walk outlived the 55 s request deadline, part of the records rotated; repeat it, or run `meta-whatsapp-server vault rotate`, which has no deadline

get.summary:
Which tenant holds a WABA, and its numbers: what an operator checks
before an unbind (decision D4).

404.description: `not_found`: not bound

delete.summary:
Unbind a WABA (decision D4: the admin unbind that lets another tenant
connect it), also the way to free a WABA whose token no longer works:
with its stored token, if usable, unsubscribe the app, at best; then
delete the token and the bindings of the WABA and its numbers.

204.description: Unbound, its token deleted (the app unsubscribed when the token allowed it)

404.description: `not_found`: not bound

get.summary: `GET /v1/events`: the tenant's events after a sequence.

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Events after this sequence: `next_after` of the previous answer.
Omit it to start at the oldest event still kept.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description:
Only these types (`KnownEventType`), comma-separated
(`message_received,status_updated`); every type when omitted.

parameters.name: phone_number_id
parameters.description: Only this business phone number's events.

410.description: `cursor_expired`: events after `after` were purged (past retention, or deleted with a tenant of the same id); start again without `after`

422.description: `invalid_request` on `after` (malformed, or past the tenant's newest sequence), `types` (not a `KnownEventType`), `phone_number_id` or `limit`

get.summary: `GET /v1/numbers`: the tenant's numbers with their connection status.

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

get.summary: `GET /v1/numbers/{pn}`: the number's live details from Meta.

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

404.description: `not_found`: no such number for this tenant

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the tenant: the same key and file never upload twice (a repeat gets the kept answer, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`)

404.description: `not_found`: no such number for this tenant

413.description: `media_too_large`: larger than its type allows or `WA_SERVER_MEDIA_MAX_BYTES`; `payload_too_large`

422.description: `invalid_request` on `type` (not a supported media type), `file` or `body` (not a form of `type` and `file`, or its framing past 16 KiB); `idempotency_key_reused`

429.description: `too_many_requests`: the tenant's rate limit, or its share of the replica's media slots busy

get.summary:
`GET /v1/numbers/{pn}/media/{media_id}`: download a file, verified
against Meta's SHA-256.

parameters.name: media_id
parameters.description: Media id (an upload's, or a received message's)

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

parameters.name: max_bytes
parameters.description:
Largest file accepted, in bytes: default and cap 16 MiB; with
`stream=true`, default and cap `WA_SERVER_MEDIA_MAX_BYTES`.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description:
Forward the bytes as they arrive (a mismatch aborts the
connection) instead of answering a verified whole file.

200.description: The file, with Meta's MIME type as `Content-Type`; whole and verified, or streamed (`stream=true`: a digest mismatch aborts the connection)

404.description: `not_found`: no such number for this tenant, or no such media on this number (another number's media id looks like a missing one)

429.description: `too_many_requests`: the tenant's rate limit, or its share of the replica's media (or stream) slots busy

502.description: `integrity` (the digest does not match: nothing of the file was answered), `media_download_failed`, `upstream`

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

404.description: `not_found`: no such number for this tenant, or no such media on this number (another number's media id looks like a missing one)

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the tenant: the same key and body never send twice (a repeat gets the kept answer, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`)

202.description: Accepted by Meta; delivery arrives as status events

404.description: `not_found`: no such number for this tenant

422.description: `invalid_request` (with `field`: `to.phone` without `+`, a `template` key the service would not send to Meta, …), `unsupported_message_type`, `idempotency_key_reused`, Meta's `template_*`, …: nothing was sent

504.description: `timeout`: the message may have been sent (`may_have_been_sent: true`)

delete.summary:
`DELETE /v1/wabas/{waba_id}`: disconnect. Unsubscribes the app from the
WABA with its token; only then deletes the token and the bindings. When
Meta refuses or fails, nothing is deleted.

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

404.description: `not_found`: no such WABA for this tenant

get.summary:
`GET /v1/wabas/{waba_id}/templates`: the WABA's templates, cached 60 s
per WABA.

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Only templates with this status, as Meta names it (`APPROVED`,
`REJECTED`, …).

200.description: A page of templates (at most 60 seconds old)

404.description: `not_found`: no such WABA for this tenant

post.summary:
`POST /v1/wabas/{waba_id}/templates`: create a template from Meta's
JSON, checked locally first.

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, scoped to the tenant: the same key and definition never create twice

201.description: Submitted for review; the result arrives as a `template_status_updated` event

404.description: `not_found`: no such WABA for this tenant

422.description: `invalid_request` (with `field`: the definition breaks a documented limit, or holds a key the service would not send to Meta), `template_rejected`, `invalid_parameter`, `idempotency_key_reused`

504.description: `timeout`: the template may have been created

delete.summary:
`DELETE /v1/wabas/{waba_id}/templates?name=[&id=]`: delete every
language of a name, or one.

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
The template's name: every language of it goes, unless `id` names
one.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One template (one language) of that name.

204.description: Deleted (an approved template's name cannot be reused for 30 days)

404.description: `not_found`: no such WABA for this tenant, or (with `id`) no template of that name and id in this WABA

422.description: `invalid_request` on `name` or `id`, or Meta's `invalid_parameter` (no template of that name)

parameters.name: WA-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant a platform key acts as

404.description: `not_found`: no such WABA for this tenant, or no such template in this WABA (another WABA's template id looks like a missing one)

AcceptedContact.description: The addressee, as Meta resolved it.

input.description: What the request addressed (phone number, BSUID or group id).

parent_user_id.description: The parent BSUID, for portfolios that use them.

user_id.description: The user's BSUID, when addressed by BSUID.

wa_id.description: The user's WhatsApp id, when addressed by phone number.

AttachWaba.description:
`POST /v1/admin/tenants/{id}/wabas`: the platform's own WABA and a
system user token with access to it.

token.description:
A system user access token with access to the WABA. Stored
encrypted; never answered or logged.

phone_number_ids.description: Every number Meta listed on it, now bound to the tenant.

voice.description: `true`: a voice message (an Ogg file with the OPUS codec).

ContactPhone.description: A contact card's phone number (content: shown as written).

wa_id.description: The contact's WhatsApp id: WhatsApp then offers "Message".

oneOf.description: A string, as Meta's pages write it.

Coordinate.description:
A coordinate in decimal degrees: Meta's pages write it as a string
(`"37.44216251868683"`); a JSON number is accepted too.

id.description:
The integrator's id (e.g. the CMS merchant id): 1 to 64 characters
of `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]`. Immutable.

name.description: A label for operators, at most 256 characters.

filename.description: File name shown, with its extension.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error answer.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error code: a KnownErrorCode today. Codes only grow within v1: handle an unknown one by its HTTP status class.

ErrorObject.description:
An error: its stable code, the service's sentence for it, whether to
retry, whether the request may have taken effect, and Meta's error when
Meta answered with one.

code.description: Stable error code (one of the `ErrorCode` values).

field.description: The request field at fault, for `invalid_request`.

oneOf.description: Meta's error, when Meta answered with one.

may_have_been_sent.description:
Whether the request may have taken effect (a message may have been
sent): if `true`, reconcile before repeating it.

message.description: The service's sentence for the code.

resumable.description: Whether the stopped operation can be resumed.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the same request later may succeed.

step.description: The step a multi-step operation stopped at.

Event.description:
One event (docs/design/server.md, section 4.4): the same envelope a
webhook endpoint (M2) receives.

data.description: The event: meta-whatsapp-rs's WebhookEvent JSON, tagged by `event` (the envelope's `type`). Its fields are Meta's, as the library normalizes them; new fields may appear.

id.description:
The event's id (`evt_…`): derived from the event, so the same event
keeps it wherever it is recorded again (until the operator rotates
the Meta app secret it is derived with); deduplicate on it. An
error, or a body that is not a webhook, seen again over an hour
later is a new event, with a new id.

phone_number_id.description: The business phone number, when the event names one.

sequence.description:
Its position among the tenant's events (each tenant has its own
sequence): increasing (with gaps), never reused; order on it.

truncated.description:
Whether `data` was left out for its size (webhook deliveries only;
always `false` here).

waba_id.description: Its WhatsApp Business Account, when the event names one.

next_after.description:
Pass as `after` to continue: the last event's sequence when more
follow, else the tenant's newest sequence (so a poll never starts
again from an old cursor).

EventType.description: An event type: a KnownEventType today. Types only grow within v1: ignore an unknown one.

GraphErrorInfo.description:
Meta's error, as the body carries it: the code and trace id, and, on
the routes that opt in, `error_data.details`. Never Meta's `message` or
titles.

details.description:
Meta's own text (`error_data.details`), on the routes that keep it:
not the service's, and not a stable value to branch on.

subcode.description: Meta's subcode, when it sent one (deprecated by Meta since v16).

HeaderMedia.description:
A media asset of an interactive header: an uploaded `id` or an
`https://` `link`.

InteractiveAction.description:
An interactive message's `action`: `buttons` for `button`; `button` and
`sections` for `list`; `name` (`cta_url`) and `parameters` for
`cta_url`.

InteractiveHeader.description: An interactive message's header: `list` takes `text` only.

InteractiveText.description: `{"text": …}`: an interactive message's body or footer.

InteractiveType.description: The interactive types the service sends.

Key.description: An API key, as listed (never its secret).

key_id.description: Public id (the part of the key between `wak_` and the secret).

last_used_at.description: When it was last used, to the minute (RFC 3339).

data.description: The keys, in id order, revoked ones included.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

KnownErrorCode.description: The error codes this version answers (a client can switch on them and let any other fall to its default).

KnownEventType.description: The event types a tenant receives today (switch on them and let any other fall to a default).

typing_indicator.description:
Also show "typing…" (until the reply, or 25 seconds): only when
about to reply. Never replayed.

type.description:
Its MIME type, one of Meta's supported media types (e.g.
`image/png`, `application/pdf`).

media_id.description:
The media id (kept by Meta for 30 days): send it in a message's
`id`.

MessageAccepted.description: Meta accepted the message; delivery comes later, as status events.

contacts.description: The addressee, as Meta resolved it.

message_id.description: The message's id (`wamid.…`): the key of its status events.

MessageRecipient.description:
Who receives a message: a phone number, a business-scoped user id
(BSUID), both (Meta then uses the phone number), or a group.

phone.description:
E.164 **with** its `+` (`+16505551234`): a number without it is
refused, as Meta would read it as local to the sender's country.

user_id.description:
Business-scoped user id (e.g. `US.13491208655302741918`), from a
webhook's `user_id`.

MessageType.description: The message types the service sends.

expires_at.description: When it stops working (RFC 3339, in the future).

name.description: A label for operators, at most 256 characters.

tenants.description: The tenants it may name with `WA-Tenant`: `"*"` or a non-empty list.

expires_at.description: When it stops working (RFC 3339, in the future).

name.description: A label for operators, at most 256 characters.

MintedKey.description: A key just minted: the whole key, shown this once, and its record.

key.description:
The key, `wak_<key_id>_<secret>`: send it as
`Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Shown once; only its digest is kept.

Number.description: A number of the tenant and its connection status.

NumberDetails.description: A number's live details, from Meta.

display_phone_number.description: The number as WhatsApp displays it.

name_status.description: Display name review status, as Meta reports it.

quality_rating.description: Quality rating, as Meta reports it (`GREEN`, `YELLOW`, `RED`, …).

status.description:
The service's connection status (`connected`: the details come
from Meta).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

ProfilePatch.description: Fields to change; absent ones stay as they are.

vertical.description:
Industry, as Meta names it (`UNDEFINED` and `NOT_A_BIZ` cannot be
set).

ReactionContent.description:
`reaction` (`messages/reaction-messages`): an emoji on a received
message; an empty `emoji` removes it.

id.description: Returned in the reply's webhook; unique in the message.

Scope.description: A scope of a tenant or platform key.

SendMessage.description: A message to send: `type` names the one content object present.

callback_data.description:
Echoed in this message's status events: set it to your own
reference (the `Idempotency-Key`, say) to reconcile.

reply_to.description: Reply to this received message (`wamid.…`); not with `reaction`.

template.description:
For `template`: Meta's template object (`name`, `language`,
`components`), as the send-template pages write it.

Template.description: A template, as Meta describes it.

status.description:
Review status, as Meta names it (`APPROVED`, `PENDING`, `REJECTED`,
`PAUSED`, …): only `APPROVED` templates can be sent.

TemplateCreated.description: A created template, as Meta answered.

TemplateDefinition.description:
A template definition in Meta's JSON (`name`, `language`, `category`,
`parameter_format`, `components`), as `templates/overview` writes it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

id.description: The integrator's id: 1 to 64 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

TenantsSpec.description: The tenants a platform key may name with WA-Tenant: "*" for any, or a non-empty list of tenant ids.

preview_url.description: Ask WhatsApp to render a preview of the first URL.

level.description: Throughput level, as Meta reports it.

name.description: A new label, at most 256 characters.

oneOf.description: `suspended` to suspend the tenant, `active` to lift it.

failed.description:
WABAs whose records could not be read or rewritten (a record under
a key no longer configured, say): rotate again, or reconnect them,
before dropping the old key.

rotated.description: Records re-encrypted under the active key.

graph_api_version.description: The Graph API version calls use, e.g. `v25.0`.

meta_whatsapp_rs_revision.description:
The meta-whatsapp-rs git revision the service was built from, when
the build recorded it (`META_WHATSAPP_RS_REVISION` at build time),
else `unknown`.

attached_at.description: When it was bound to the tenant (RFC 3339).

WabaBinding.description: A bound WABA, as the operator sees it.

numbers.description: Its numbers and their connection status.

tenant_id.description: The tenant it is bound to.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last one.

api_key.description: An API key: a tenant key, a platform key (with the WA-Tenant header) or an admin key (/v1/admin only).
